description:
# immich-media-patches v2.0.3

Morphe patches that make an app's built-in photo picker browse a self-hosted
[Immich](https://immich.app) server — nothing is synced to the device, and the
originals are what get uploaded.

**Supported in this release**

| App | Base | Verified |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `com.discord` | 351.11 - Stable APKM + [Venus Patches](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches) 1.21.1 | yes — Android 16 |
| `com.tumblr` | 47.0.0.108 APKM + [HushTumblr](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTumblr) 0.0.11 | yes — Android 16 |

`patches-2.0.3.mpp` — SHA-256: `42d04bcf01f39e02bc705434693ef415a6d719b61bae422076db941aa73adb99`

## Changes in this release

- Compatibility metadata now mirrors the community base patch sets: both entries
  declare `ApkFileType.APKM`, the bundle version code (`351011` / `1470000108`) and
  `minSdk 26`; Tumblr also declares the genuine Tumblr signer. Morphe therefore
  accepts the same **original APKM** for the base bundle and these patches, and the
  GUI lists both apps as normal supported apps.
- Verified by patching the stock APKM with **Venus Patches 1.21.1 + these patches**
  (Discord) and **HushTumblr 0.0.11 + these patches** (Tumblr) in one run, installing
  the results, and streaming 1000-row bridge pages from both.
- No functional change to the picker patches over v2.0.2.

> HushTumblr 0.0.11 needs Morphe **2.2.0 or newer**. These patches on their own still
> load on Morphe 1.15.0.

## Recommended patch flow

Start from the original APKM and select the base bundle's default patches plus
**Immich photo picker**:

```bash
java -jar morphe-desktop-2.2.0-all.jar patch \
  -p patches-1.21.1.mpp \
  -p patches-2.0.3.mpp -e "Immich photo picker" \
  -o out/discord.apk \
  discord-351.11.apkm
```

Morphe can also fetch this bundle straight from the repository:
`--patches=https://github.com/anoraktrend/immich-media-patches`.

### Bridge mode (recommended)

Build the custom Immich app from the fork:
`https://github.com/anoraktrend/immich-android-bridge`, branch `android-bridge`
(commit `b838c7390`), following `docs/v2-orchestrator.md`. Sign it with **your own
keystore, and sign these patches with the same key** (`--keystore …`) — the bridge is
guarded by a signature-level permission.

## Notes and honest limitations

- Replacing a store install needs a full uninstall (signature change): back up the
  app's data, restore it afterwards, fix ownership and **re-grant runtime
  permissions**.
- Android 11+ fully supported; Android 8–9 works except local-only previews.
- Version pins are exact. Other Discord/Tumblr releases are untested.
- Patch your own copies. Discord and Tumblr remain their owners' work; these patches
  are The Unlicense (public domain), the Immich fork is AGPL-3.0, and the base patch
  sets are their authors' (GPL-3.0).

release_notes:
# immich-media-patches v2.0.1

Morphe patches that make an app's built-in photo picker browse a self-hosted
[Immich](https://immich.app) server — nothing is synced to the device, and the
originals are what get uploaded.

**Supported in this release**

| App | Version | Verified |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `com.discord` | 351.11 - Stable | yes — device, Android 13 |
| `com.tumblr` | 47.0.0.108 | yes — device, Android 13 |

`patches-2.0.1.mpp` — SHA-256: `374551b58eed5447523b741219d06dc31d7378d4e6823d8f96d76b6a0a6534a3`

## Changes in this release

- The patched apps now log their configuration mode at provider start
  (`config: bridge mode …`, `provider ready … mode=bridge`) — previously the init
  order dropped those lines. No functional change over v2.0.0.

## Verified credential-free

Patching **with no options at all** produces APKs with no baked credentials, and on
device: cold picker processes serve the timeline through the Immich app; evicted
originals re-download through it; `am force-stop` on the Immich app does not break the
pickers (the system restarts it on demand to serve the bridge); disabling or
uninstalling the app leaves the picker empty and stable.

## What's new in v2

- **Full gallery.** The picker shows what the Immich app itself shows: local
  (not-yet-backed-up) assets and remote assets interleaved, read from the app's own
  timeline database. Fresh photos appear before backup; backed-up assets deduplicate
  to their remote copy.
- **The Immich app becomes the orchestrator.** When the (forked) Immich app is
  installed and signed in, patched apps take the server URL and session from it — no
  configuration at all, and credentials live in exactly one place.
- **Patch options are optional.** Leave `immichBaseUrl` / `immichApiKey` empty for
  bridge mode, or set them to bake a fallback for devices without the Immich app
  (direct mode, the v1 behaviour).
- Previews are WebP thumbnails; uploads are the untouched originals.

## Using it

```bash
java -jar morphe-desktop-1.15.0-all.jar patch \
  -p patches-2.0.1.mpp \
  -e "Immich photo picker" \
  -o app-patched.apk \
  app.apk
```

Morphe can also fetch this bundle straight from the repository:
`--patches=https://github.com/anoraktrend/immich-media-patches`.

### Bridge mode (recommended)

Build the custom Immich app from the fork:
`https://github.com/anoraktrend/immich-android-bridge`, branch `android-bridge`
(commit `b838c7390`), following `docs/v2-orchestrator.md`. Sign it with **your own
keystore, and sign these patches with the same key** (`--keystore …`) — the bridge is
guarded by a signature-level permission.

### Direct mode

Pass `-O immichBaseUrl=https://immich.example.com -O immichApiKey=…` at patch time.
Works on any device without the Immich app; a read-only API key is enough.

## Notes and honest limitations

- Use **merged APKs** (splits folded in); the patch strips `requiredSplitTypes`.
- Replacing a store install needs a full uninstall (signature change): back up the
  app's data, restore it afterwards, fix ownership and **re-grant runtime
  permissions** — Android keeps grants in system state, not app data.
- Android 11+ fully supported; Android 8–9 works except local-only previews.
- Version pins are exact. Other Discord/Tumblr releases are untested — for other
  apps, see `docs/new-patches.md`.
- Patch your own copies. Discord and Tumblr remain their owners' work; these patches
  are The Unlicense (public domain) and the Immich fork is AGPL-3.0.
